text: Being here, I feel a mix of curiosity and detachment. The muffled mechanical murmurs—"Brrrr Brrrr"—echo the sterile hum of modernity. The glassed meeting room bustles with intent, but from the corridor I sense only the division between observer and participant. Moving to the R&D exhibit, vibrant colors and bold text ignite my wonder for progress, yet I am haunted by the distance between knowledge and experience. Am I a guest in a world of perpetual innovation, or merely a silent witness to its ceaseless grind?
